messages:
kevin: Hey eng-ml — GreenWave (customer) asked us to onboard greenwave-7b-v2 for a 7-day pilot. Key asks: 4-bit quantized serving, p95 < 120ms for single-token sampling, canary in hosted then dedicated. Data is non-PII. Timeline: pilot in 7 days. Can we triage? cc @ajay @maria

ajay: Quick q's — streaming needed? peak QPS? are they using a custom tokenizer or any finetune artifacts?

maria: Need to triage scope quickly. Proposed minimal bring-up checklist: 1) get HF repo / safetensors link + config 2) confirm tokenizer + sample prompts (10 prompts) 3) FP16 smoke perf on dev pool 4) quantize to 4-bit with our rw-quant pipeline 5) run functional eval set (regression + safety) 6) perf + cost projection, canary config, rollback plan

sophia: I can run the FP16 -> q8 -> q4 smoke tonight on a100-dev. Need weights in safetensors or .pt. Also need a tiny eval set (50 samples) that represents their tail prompts.

kevin: they said no streaming, mostly sync calls. Peak expected ~15 QPS, typical 2-3 QPS. Token lengths avg 80, max 512. They also asked about embeddings on the same model.

ajay: embeddings on same 4-bit path is risky. For now propose ember fallback: route embedding calls to a distilled embed model. We'll add routing policy in canary.

sophia: agreed — 4-bit sampling for generation only. embeddings -> run separate int8/FP16 embed model.

maria: I'll draft the eval blocks. For regression we need: perplexity diff, generation quality on 10 golden prompts, and safety classifier pass rate. Also add latency/cost bench.

sophia: quick perf commands for benching:
```
# fp16 smoke run
rw-infer bench --model ./greenwave-7b-v2 --dtype fp16 --seq 128 --batch 1 --iters 50
# quantize to 4-bit (dev tool)
rw-quantize --model ./greenwave-7b-v2 --target q4 --out ./q4/
# q4 bench
rw-infer bench --model ./q4/greenwave-7b-v2 --dtype q4 --seq 128 --batch 1 --iters 100
```

ajay: I'll open the onboarding ticket (RW-3421) and add checklist + canary route + fallback. Adding @sophia for perf, @maria for evals.

deploy-bot: New onboarding ticket created: RW-3421 by ajay. Canaries: hosted/canary-greenwave, fallback: base-7b.

kevin: Customer requires determinism? also confirm whether top_k/top_p sampling will be used. If deterministic we might need sampling seed approach.

sophia: They said deterministic outputs are preferred for scoring, but generation for UX can be stochastic. We'll expose a seed param and a deterministic flag in the canary. Deterministic sampling on quantized weights is flaky — will validate.

maria: Risk notes: 1) quality regressions vs fp32 may show up on long prompt completions; 2) 4-bit beam/search behaviors can change ranking; include eval hooks to compare logprobs.

kevin: OK P0 for the 7-day pilot. Assignments: sophia -> perf/quant smoke, maria -> eval harness + regression checks, ajay -> ticket + canary routing + customer comms. Please post quick status updates here when you have smoke numbers. :thumbsup:
